## Studies and tools using clustermole

Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics studies across several species and tissues have used clustermole for cell type annotation.

## Add your publication

If you know of a peer-reviewed publication that explicitly uses clustermole or its marker database, please [open an issue](https://github.com/igordot/clustermole/issues).

If you use clustermole in your work, please cite it.

```{r citation, eval=FALSE}
citation("clustermole")
```
